svg.title: Four-Week Roadmap to Live Lead and Call Distribution
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-ping-post-and-call-routing-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Four-Week Roadmap to Live Lead and Call Distribution; subtitle: Payloads, testing, buyer guardrails and billable call rules; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Map Buyer Payloads; deliverable: Payload type (form or JSON) set before any edit, required fields confirmed with each buyer, non-required fields stripped from the ping.; gate: Payload type locked first, since switching it resets the builder (Lead Prosper).; week: Week 2; title: Test the Ping Post Auction; deliverable: lp_test set to 1 on ping and post, with 15-second ping and 30-second post timeouts excluding lagging buyers (boberdoo.com).; gate: lp_test and lp_action test removed before go-live.; week: Week 3; title: Set Buyer Guardrails; deliverable: Max best price ceiling on every dynamic buyer, refund cap at 15% over the past 30 days, and 'yes but sold non-exclusively' resale above cost.; gate: Refund cap in place before the first invoice goes out.; week: Week 4; title: Route Calls and Automate Follow-Up; deliverable: Pay-per-call at $100 per call qualified by duration thresholds such as 90 seconds, plus a voice AI callback within 60 seconds and a three-step SMS sequence.; gate: No call billed below the buyer's duration qualifier, as with the 47-second call.; caption: Capture the lead, route it in seconds to the buyer who pays most, and follow up before a competitor does.; assumptions note: The week-by-week cadence is an editorial ordering of steps the practitioners describe, not a schedule any of them reported.; note: Sources - boberdoo.com (DSbDVWpyXUI @ 00:15:43 and 00:17:44, yCAVYNpSdZI @ 00:22:50), Lead Prosper (gX0fjRlg1lg, _1N3fncM-Ss), Local SEO Made Easy (Bu_9XhXpDSs), Jason Grossman (Ot93upK_YX4 @ 00:52:38).
